{{Quote|I've heard a lot about you, Phoenix Squadron... You blew up the comm tower on Lothal ''and'' Tarkin's Star Destroyer.|Gold Two to Ezra Bridger and Garazeb Orrelios|<ref name="Secret Cargo" />}}
"'''[[Gold Two]]'''" was the [[callsign]] given to a [[Gender|female]] [[human]] Rebel [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] serving under [[Captain]] [[Jon Vander]] in [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]]. She was one of the squadron members who escorted Rebel [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]]'s [[starship]], the ''[[Chandrila Mistress]]'', to an important meeting on [[Dantooine]]. When the convoy rendezvoused with the starship ''[[Ghost]]'', of [[Phoenix Cell]], for refueling, Gold Two argued with some of the [[Spectres]] about some of their past missions, believing that the group attracted too much [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] attention. When Imperial ships arrived, forcing the Rebels to flee, Gold Two was going to pilot her [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-wing]]; unfortunately, she was knocked out when Imperial fire hit the ''Ghost'', and [[Ezra Bridger]] flew her fighter instead. After she recovered, Gold Two was present in the ''Ghost''{{'s}} [[cockpit]] when Mothma delivered the speech that led to the founding of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Kid... you can fly in my squadron any day.|Gold Two to Ezra Bridger|<ref name="Secret Cargo" />}}
The woman known as Gold Two was part of the [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-wing starfighter]] squadron known as [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]], which was affiliated with the rebellion. In [[2 BBY]], Gold Two and her fellow pilots escorted<ref name="Secret Cargo" /> a [[Taylander shuttle]] ''[[Chandrila Mistress]]''<ref name="Chandrila Mistress DB">{{Databank|chandrila-mistress|Chandrila Mistress}}</ref> carrying the outspoken [[Senator]] and rebel [[Mon Mothma]] into hiding. Mothma had incurred the wrath of [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] by denouncing the [[Ghorman Massacre]]. Mothma's colleague Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] arranged for Gold Squadron and Mothma's ship to rendezvous with members of the [[Spectres]] rebel cell in deep space.<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

[[File:Secret_Cargo.jpg|thumb|left|250px|"Gold Two" sits aboard the ''Ghost'' while Mon Mothma delivers her speech.]]

Gold Squadron and Mothma's ship arrived shortly after the [[Spectres]]' [[VCX-100 light freighter]] ''[[Ghost]]'' had destroyed a [[X3-13|tactical infiltration pod]] carrying an [[E-XD-series infiltrator droid]]. The ''[[Ghost]]'' then docked with Mothma's freighter and proceeded to refuel Gold Squadron's Y-wings. While aboard the ''Ghost'', she conversed with the Spectres [[Garazeb Orrelios]] and [[Ezra Bridger]] about their role in blowing up the [[Imperial Communications Center]] on [[Lothal]] and [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]'s [[Star Destroyer]] ''[[Sovereign]]''.<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

When Zeb claimed responsibility for the latter, Gold Two chastised them for their stunt because it had caused the [[Galactic Empire]] to tighten security across the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. When she blamed the Spectres for making their life harder, Zeb retorted that they like doing things the hard way. Gold Two's [[Captain]] [[Jon Vander]] then joined the conversation and reprimanded the Spectres for alerting the Empire by destroying the infiltration pod. Ezra then responded that the other rebels should have given them more information rather than being so secretive.<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

When the Spectres' [[astromech droid]] [[C1-10P|Chopper]] uttered an insult, Gold Two took offense. The Spectres' [[captain]] [[Hera Syndulla]] tried to calm the argument by saying that her crew did the best with the information they had. Mon Mothma's senatorial aide [[Erskin Semaj]] then added that the tactical probe droid was probably looking for them. Shortly later, an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]] and [[Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti''-class cruiser]] exited [[hyperspace]] and began attacking the rebel ships. Gold Two fell off a platform and was knocked unconscious. Hera told Zeb to take the wounded pilot to the med bay while Ezra flew her starfighter.<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

After the rebels eluded a [[Operation Handoff|trap]] set by [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] in the [[Archeon Nebula]], the rebels managed to reach the planet [[Dantooine]]. There, Gold Two praised Ezra for his bravery and piloting skills and invited him to fly with her squadron. Shortly later, Gold Two watched as Mon Mothma gave an impassioned speech urging [[the galaxy]] to rise up in rebellion. Shortly later, the rebel fleet arrived above Dantooine and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] was formed.<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

==Personality and traits==
Gold Two was a brusque and hardened [[Gender|female]] [[human]] [[pilot]] who flew with Gold Squadron during the [[Imperial Era|Age of the Empire]]. She was critical of the Spectres for taking risky actions against the Empire and making it harder for other rebel cells to operate. However, she gained a better respect for the Spectres after they helped her and her fellow rebels travel with Mon Mothma safely through the [[Archeon pass]]. As a gesture of reconciliation, she invited Ezra to fly with her squadron.<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gold Two first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|Season Three]] episode "[[Secret Cargo]]," which first premiered on [[Disney XD]] on [[March 4]], [[2017]]. She was voiced by [[Mary Elizabeth McGlynn]], who also voiced the antagonistic [[Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]].
